title: Canadian Oat Pilaf
description: A hearty and comforting pilaf dish from Canada, made with nutty oats and a variety of spices.
instructions: Heat the olive oil in a large saucepan over medium heat.
Add the chopped nuts and cook until lightly browned, about 3-4 minutes.
Add the oat and pilaf to the saucepan, stirring to combine.
Cook for 5-7 minutes, or until the oats are toasted and fragrant.
Add the thyme, salt, and pepper, stirring to combine.
Continue cooking for an additional 2-3 minutes, or until the pilaf is heated through.
Serve hot, garnished with chopped nuts if desired.
